description: Source code for an LCD controller managing a menu system on a 20x4 display, including menu initialization, joystick input handling, and display updates with sensor data.

classes.name: MenuItem
classes.description: Represents a menu item in the LCD menu tree.

classes.name: MenuTree
classes.description: Manages the hierarchical menu structure and visible items.

methods.name: onJoystick
methods.description: Handles joystick button presses to navigate the menu.

methods.name: appendStr
methods.description: Appends a string suffix to a buffer.

methods.name: initLcdController
methods.description: Initializes the LCD menu system and stream buffer.

methods.name: lcdPrintf
methods.description: Formats and prints a string to the LCD.

methods.name: showLine
methods.description: Displays specific sensor or system info on the LCD line.

methods.name: fillWithSpaces
methods.description: Fills remaining LCD line space with spaces.

methods.name: updateHD44780lcd
methods.description: Updates the LCD display with current menu and sensor data.
